description: React component for displaying and managing Single Sign-On (SSO) connection information, including SAML and OIDC configurations, with functionality to delete connections and copy URLs to clipboard.

methods.name: ConnectionInfo
methods.description: Main React component that displays SSO connection details and provides delete functionality.

methods.name: SAMLInfo
methods.description: Component displaying SAML-specific connection details, including ACS URL and Entity ID, with copy-to-clipboard buttons.

methods.name: OIDCInfo
methods.description: Component displaying OIDC callback URL with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: deleteConnection
methods.description: Function to trigger deletion of the SSO connection via mutation.
